propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock (306 ms per test × 589 consumers), dominated by per-test git init + config + commit spawning (54 processes, 268 ms).

Session-scoped template built once per xdist worker and copied per test reduces fixture time from 306 ms to 22.3 ms (13.7×), but requires four fix-ups: rewrite worktree pointers, isolate snapshot store by per-test REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR, re-randomize .env-id and .signing-key, and reset ensures._pending_cache.

Bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op when run against a copy (validates paths, leaves copy bound to template's object store and refs), and corrupts the source when run in-place, so it must not be used; the guard rejects half-fixed copies via git worktree list --porcelain.

Template fixture must build in its own MonkeyPatch context with REBAR_ROOT pinned to template dir and XDG_CONFIG_HOME empty, deleting REBAR_TRACKER_DIR and REBAR_TRACKER_BRANCH env vars and resetting config cache, to prevent ambient test environment from contaminating the template.

A tier-wide autouse guard asserts all paths in git worktree list --porcelain resolve inside REBAR_ROOT, catching pointer corruption and protecting future fixtures; --git-common-dir is insufficient (derives from .git alone, misses stale gitdir).

Deliberate coverage of build-from-scratch path preserved in tests/interfaces/store/test_init_idempotent_scratch.py and test_e4_init.py; ambiguous conftest name resolved by extracting helpers into uniquely-named tests/interfaces/_store_template.py.
